title: Coordinate Plane Worksheets: Reading Ordered Pairs
intro: Model the order of coordinates before introducing faster plotting.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Start at the origin and move horizontally for the first number, then vertically for the second in these first-quadrant examples.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

(3, 2) means three units right from zero and two units up.

The first number is the x-coordinate. The second number is the y-coordinate.

Ask your student

What changes if we reverse the two numbers?

If your student needs help

If the student moves up first, trace the path from the origin and label the axes.
